question: Should default openclaw doctor --lint omit legacy state, session transcript/snapshot, and skills readiness checks while keeping them available through --all or --only?
rationale: This is an intentional diagnostic-surface compatibility choice: code and tests can prove the selection mechanics, but they cannot decide the desired default noise/discoverability tradeoff for existing automation.

options.title: Accept the narrower default profile
options.body: Keep these checks explicit-only and land once the stacked parent and docs are ready.

options.title: Keep selected checks default-enabled
options.body: Leave any check family maintainers still want in default lint enabled, then adjust the audit expectations.

options.title: Hold for stack cleanup
options.body: Wait for the write-config findings PR to land or ask for a rebase before deciding this audit slice.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrower default profile
recommendation.body: Keep these checks explicit-only and land once the stacked parent and docs are ready.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and Doctor orchestration history make this the best maintainer-side routing candidate for a default-policy choice.
